messages:
Nora: quick note  I'm about to run a preview for `cfg.cache.eviction_smoothing` on staging in 10m. goal is to detect "spill" behavior without changing live caches.
Diego: ok. preview-only (no enforcement) sounds right. what's the smoothing delta?
Nora: moving smoothing from .2 -> .6 (exponential window). preview will compute new eviction decisions and write a preview snapshot.
Sam: telemetry ask: please avoid per-tenant metrics. emit cohort-level aggregates like `cache.eviction.preview_spill_rate{cohort="c2"}` + a sampled tenant event stream `cache.preview_samples` with default 1/300 sampling.
Elena: runtime note: preview endpoints currently return 200 sync. can we change preview apply to 202 + `preview_token` and `estimated_propagation_ms` so UIs and clients know it's async?
Nora: good call. preview apply will return 202 + preview_token. added `/preview/{token}/status` for polling: {state, estimated_propagation_ms, affected_ranges}. emergency sync path unchanged.
Diego: for alerts, use a per-shard boolean gauge `cache.preview_spill_detected{shard="r-7"}` instead of tenant labels. then emit a sampled event with tenant hash to secure logs when the gauge flips. avoids cardinality storms.
Sam: console UX: please show a compact side-by-side: current vs preview aggregates (p50/p95 miss_rate, spill_rate, avg_evicts). add an "Inspect samples" button to open the sampled-event list (redacted tenant hashes).
Elena: ACK modal requirements: show preview_token, git sha, who initiated preview, human-readable diff bullets, and two-checkbox confirmation if auto-pause thresholds are above default. saves mistakes.
Nora: adding audit ledger entries: store approver, preview_token, commit sha, ack_timestamp, and return an `audit_lock` token after ACK to use for any rollback.
Diego: runbook: auto-pause preview if `cache.preview_spill_rate` increases by >1.8% absolute for a cohort OR if `cache.preview_spill_detected` fires 3x in 12m. infra-bot should create an incident draft with the preview snapshot attached.
Sam: replay job: persist preview snapshots + sampled traces to S3 (14d retention). create a deterministic replay that replays sampled inputs under both prev/new logic and emits a small CSV summary per preview_token for Optimize (cpu_ms, avg tokens, cost_delta).
Elena: API schema change: preview response include `affected_ranges` (shard ranges) so Console can pre-render heatmaps; include `estimated_propagation_ms` and `preview_size_estimate` (approx number of affected keys).
Nora: metrics detail: cohort-level histogram `cache.eviction.preview_latency_ms` + boolean gauges per-shard for leak detection. sampled tenant events go to secure-logs with 1/300 default but runtime knob available.
Diego: ensure sampling rate is runtime-configurable and plumbed through Dedicated/Private builds. we might need to ramp to 1/50 for small cohorts.
Sam: UX idea: when preview active, Console should surface a small timeline with preview start, any auto-pause events, and a button to "Export evidence" (zips snapshot + sampled traces + replay CSV). handy for oncall handoff.
Elena: security: sampled tenant hashes must be salted and one-way hashed before leaving runtime to avoid reversible identifiers. add that to the audit checklist.
Nora: ok adding salt+one-way hash for sample events. will also add the replay job queue to avoid colliding with nightly batch jobs (run T+3h by default).
infra-bot: preview-created by nora/eviction-smoothing-preview  diff: 4 files changed  http://ci.redwood/internal/8821
Diego: please include the exact metric names and shard gauge labels in the PR so SRE can wire alerts. tag me.
Nora: will do. launching preview in 10. ping me for the PR link.
Sam: thanks y'all. this UX + preview-token async flow should reduce accidental sync expectations. :thumbsup:
